# VibePro

VibePro is a repository-local CLI for investigating what should change with an AI host and connecting that reasoning to implementation and PR review. Optional judgment investigation prepares model requests, reads explicitly supplied existing Graphify artifacts and source, and requires reinterpretation when new evidence arrives. The host supplies model responses; the CLI does not autonomously call models, generate Graphify artifacts, or fetch external evidence. Candidates and unknowns remain advisory, not automatically adopted. Its workflow uses structured Story and Spec records that require authoring and maintenance. Reference validation and recorded test results are review inputs, not proof of semantic correctness or safety. Approval and merge remain with people and repository policy.

Canonical manual: https://vibepro.pages.dev/
Source: https://github.com/Unson-LLC/vibepro
License: Apache-2.0

The public manual intentionally excludes repository-internal Story, Architecture, Spec, contract, and runtime evidence corpora. Check the installed CLI's help for the command contract. Historical release notes can describe removed capabilities; the former broad Gate DAG is retired. Optional engineering-judgment support is advisory.
